Metric: Annualised return (CAGR, geometric)
Basis dependence: gross and net
Definition: Terminal value of the compounded daily return series raised to 1/years, minus one. Years run from the session before the first in-window return. Gross compounds strategy_daily.csv 'gross_return'; net compounds 'net_return'.
Canonical source: outputs/strategy_daily.csv; net published as 'CAGR' in outputs/strategy_metrics.csv
Reconciliation: net matches published CAGR to 1e-9

Metric: Annualised volatility (daily sd x sqrt(252))
Basis dependence: gross and net
Definition: Sample standard deviation of daily returns scaled by sqrt(252). The strategy targets 7% ex-ante; the realised figure is the outturn.
Reconciliation: net matches published volatility to 1e-9

Metric: Sharpe ratio (daily, rf = 0, x sqrt(252))
Basis dependence: gross and net
Definition: Mean daily return divided by its standard deviation, times sqrt(252), risk-free rate zero. Futures returns are already excess of financing, so rf = 0 is the right convention here rather than a simplification.
Canonical source: outputs/strategy_daily.csv; net published as 'Naive daily Sharpe (sqrt252, rf=0)'
Reconciliation: net matches published Sharpe to 1e-9

Metric: Maximum drawdown (daily compounded, peak to trough)
Basis dependence: gross and net
Definition: Minimum of equity / running maximum of equity - 1, on daily compounded returns, with the running maximum seeded at 1.0 so a drawdown from the first session is measurable.
Reconciliation: net matches published max drawdown to 1e-9

Metric: Return-to-drawdown (CAGR / |max drawdown|), i.e. Calmar
Basis dependence: gross and net
Definition: Annualised return divided by the absolute value of the maximum drawdown, each taken on the same basis (gross with gross, net with net).
Canonical source: derived; net published as 'Calmar' in outputs/strategy_metrics.csv
Reconciliation: net matches published Calmar to 1e-9

Metric: Hit rate - DAILY win rate (share of sessions with a positive return)
Basis dependence: gross and net
Definition: Share of in-window sessions whose return is strictly positive. This is the portfolio-level hit rate, not a per-trade one.
Canonical source: outputs/strategy_daily.csv; net published as 'Daily win rate'
Reconciliation: net matches published daily win rate to 1e-9

Metric: Hit rate - TRADE-LEVEL win rate (closed episodes with P&L > $0.01)
Basis dependence: gross and net
Definition: Closed directional episodes assigned to the window by EXIT date, counted as a win when realised P&L exceeds one cent (the cent tolerance stops floating-point dust manufacturing wins). Net uses 'Net P&L USD'; gross uses 'Gross P&L USD'. Below 50% by design: this is a trend book that loses often and small, wins rarely and large.
Canonical source: outputs/strategy_trade_episodes.csv; net published as 'Trade win rate'
Reconciliation: net matches published trade win rate to 1e-9

Metric: Number of trades - CLOSED trade episodes (completed round trips)
Basis dependence: basis-invariant (an execution fact, not a P&L fact)
Definition: A directional episode runs from a flat-to-nonzero entry until the position returns to flat or flips sign; resizes and rolls inside it do not start a new episode. Assigned to the window by exit date.
Reconciliation: matches published closed-episode count exactly

Metric: Number of trades - OPEN/censored episodes at window end (context)
Basis dependence: basis-invariant (an execution fact, not a P&L fact)
Definition: Episodes live at the window end, excluded from the closed-episode statistics above. Reported so the closed count is not read as the whole book.
Reconciliation: matches published open/censored count exactly

Metric: Number of trades - RAW market-sessions with a nonzero fill
Basis dependence: basis-invariant (an execution fact, not a P&L fact)
Definition: Sum of strategy_daily.csv 'filled_markets': the number of (market, session) pairs on which a nonzero quantity actually executed. This counts execution events, not round trips, and is the number an operations desk would size against. Roll legs are executed separately and are not in this count.
Reconciliation: not separately published; derived from the canonical ledger

Metric: Average holding period (sessions)
Basis dependence: basis-invariant (an execution fact, not a P&L fact)
Definition: Mean 'Holding sessions' across closed episodes in the window.
Reconciliation: matches published average holding sessions to 1e-9

Metric: Average holding period (months, at 21 sessions per month)
Basis dependence: basis-invariant (an execution fact, not a P&L fact)
Definition: Sessions / 21, i.e. 252/12. Twenty-one is the rebalance cadence, so the figure reads directly as 'about N rebalance cycles per position'.
Reconciliation: derived; no separate published value

Metric: Turnover - annualised NOTIONAL turnover (multiples of NAV per year, rebalance leg only)
Basis dependence: basis-invariant (an execution fact, not a P&L fact)
Definition: Sum over sessions of |traded notional| / prior NAV, divided by the window's calendar span in years. Scale free, so it survives NAV compounding, and it is the reading most people mean by 'turnover'. REBALANCE LEG ONLY: the ledger stores roll turnover as an aggregate contract increment, so a roll notional cannot be reconstructed. True all-in notional turnover is therefore higher than shown.
Canonical source: recomputed from the frozen backtest; full window published as 'annual_rebalance_notional_turnover_over_nav' in outputs/benchmarks/benchmark_comparison.csv
Reconciliation: full window matches the published benchmark figure to 1e-9

Metric: Turnover - annualised CONTRACT turnover, all-in (rebalance + roll)
Basis dependence: basis-invariant (an execution fact, not a P&L fact)
Definition: Sum of daily total contract turnover divided by the window's calendar span in years. NOT scale free: the book compounds about 22x over the full window and buys proportionally more contracts for the same risk, so the rise from the development window to the out-of-sample window is mostly NAV growth, not more trading. Use the notional row above instead.
Canonical source: outputs/strategy_daily.csv; full window published as 'annual_total_turnover_contracts' in benchmark_comparison.csv
Reconciliation: full window matches the published benchmark figure to 1e-9

Metric: Turnover - annualised CONTRACT turnover, rebalance leg
Basis dependence: basis-invariant (an execution fact, not a P&L fact)
Definition: The discretionary leg: monthly target changes that survive the 25% no-trade band.
Reconciliation: full window matches published 'annual_rebalance_turnover_contracts'

Metric: Turnover - annualised CONTRACT turnover, roll leg
Basis dependence: basis-invariant (an execution fact, not a P&L fact)
Definition: The non-discretionary leg: contract rolls forced by delivery. About 64% of all-in contract turnover over the full window, which is why roll cost is modelled explicitly rather than folded into a single spread number.
Reconciliation: full window matches published 'annual_roll_turnover_contracts'

Metric: Total estimated costs - annualised, all-in (% of NAV per year)
Basis dependence: net only (cost is the gross-to-net bridge)
1990-2004 development (gross): n/a - gross is pre-cost by construction
2005-2014 out-of-sample (gross): n/a - gross is pre-cost by construction
1990-2014 full (gross): n/a - gross is pre-cost by construction
Definition: Mean daily cost as a fraction of the NAV that bore it, times 252. This is the scale-free cost reading and the one that is comparable across windows. Costs comprise half-spread, slippage, commission, exchange/regulatory fees, square-root market impact and roll cost.
Reconciliation: matches published annual cost drag to 1e-9

Metric: Total estimated costs - annualised, FIXED component (% of NAV per year)
Basis dependence: net only (cost is the gross-to-net bridge)
1990-2004 development (gross): n/a - gross is pre-cost by construction
2005-2014 out-of-sample (gross): n/a - gross is pre-cost by construction
1990-2014 full (gross): n/a - gross is pre-cost by construction
Definition: Spread + slippage + commission + exchange/regulatory fees + roll cost, i.e. everything that does not scale with order size relative to volume.
Reconciliation: matches published annual fixed-cost drag to 1e-9

Metric: Total estimated costs - annualised, IMPACT component (% of NAV per year)
Basis dependence: net only (cost is the gross-to-net bridge)
1990-2004 development (gross): n/a - gross is pre-cost by construction
2005-2014 out-of-sample (gross): n/a - gross is pre-cost by construction
1990-2014 full (gross): n/a - gross is pre-cost by construction
Definition: Square-root market-impact charge on order size relative to median traded volume. Small at this book size (about 9% of all-in cost over the full window) and the component that grows fastest with AUM.
Reconciliation: matches published annual impact-cost drag to 1e-9

Metric: Total estimated costs - cumulative USD, all-in
Basis dependence: net only (cost is the gross-to-net bridge)
1990-2004 development (gross): n/a - gross is pre-cost by construction
2005-2014 out-of-sample (gross): n/a - gross is pre-cost by construction
1990-2014 full (gross): n/a - gross is pre-cost by construction
Definition: Sum of 'transaction_cost_usd' over the window on a book started at $1,000,000 in 1990 and compounded thereafter. NOT comparable across windows: the book compounds, so a later window pays more dollars for the same proportional cost. Read the annualised % rows for cross-window comparison.
Reconciliation: fixed + impact asserted equal to all-in within 1e-6 relative

Metric: Total estimated costs - cumulative USD, FIXED component
Basis dependence: net only (cost is the gross-to-net bridge)
1990-2004 development (gross): n/a - gross is pre-cost by construction
2005-2014 out-of-sample (gross): n/a - gross is pre-cost by construction
1990-2014 full (gross): n/a - gross is pre-cost by construction
Definition: Sum of 'fixed_execution_cost_usd' over the window.
Reconciliation: component of the asserted fixed + impact = all-in identity

Metric: Total estimated costs - cumulative USD, IMPACT component
Basis dependence: net only (cost is the gross-to-net bridge)
1990-2004 development (gross): n/a - gross is pre-cost by construction
2005-2014 out-of-sample (gross): n/a - gross is pre-cost by construction
1990-2014 full (gross): n/a - gross is pre-cost by construction
Definition: Sum of 'market_impact_cost_usd' over the window.
Reconciliation: component of the asserted fixed + impact = all-in identity

Metric: Average exposure - gross notional as a multiple of NAV
Basis dependence: basis-invariant (an execution fact, not a P&L fact)
Definition: Mean of daily gross notional / NAV. Above 1x because a 7% volatility target across 59 individually low-volatility futures needs notional leverage. Targets are capped at 5.0x gross at each decision point; the realised peak is 5.11x because positions drift between rebalances.
Reconciliation: matches published average gross notional multiple to 1e-9

Metric: Average exposure - number of markets held
Basis dependence: basis-invariant (an execution fact, not a P&L fact)
Definition: Mean daily count of markets with a nonzero position. Rises over time as the universe's liquidity gate admits more of the 59 markets.
Reconciliation: matches published average markets held to 1e-9
